Avant is one of the playable characters in Grand Quest: Those Who Lead. He helped Reed and the others during their journey. He was also the father of one of the Six Heroes, Vargas.

sections.title: Relationships
sections.content: Avant is the father of Vargas, as both can found together in Genius's Challenge.

sections.title: Trivia
sections.content: - Avant is the owner of both Dandelga and Dandemagus. Avant is owned Dandelga from Galant in the past, but he owned Dandemagus in the present after Avant had been deceased. Avant's Dandemagus had been shown in the artwork of Undying Flame Avant.
